text:
Ivy L.: FYI — we have a visitor with a service dog coming at 2:15pm for a 30m walkthrough. they also mentioned bringing an oversized rolled poster (2.5ft x 6ft) that courier will drop at 1:50pm. can we make sure there’s a calm corner for the dog and temp badges printed with 'access needs' on them?
Sam (People Ops): thanks Ivy. we can reserve the quiet corner (by the planter). Front desk can print badges with note field. Frontdesk Bot  can you pre-flag 'accessible' on the badge template? :paw_print:
Frontdesk Bot: Accessible badge note available. Template: `visitor-access-notes-v1.pdf`. Please upload guest list to `visitor-uploads/`. Max temp badges per print job: 10.
Kenji (Facilities): poster delivery ok to stage at loading dock. pallet jack reserved if needed. please label poster tube `POSTER-IVY-3188884444`. also i'll put out a small rug for the dog near the planter area.
Mailroom Bot: Delivery alert: oversized rolled item for "Ivy L." ETA 13:50 via DHL. Requires photo on acceptance and label `POSTER-IVY-3188884444`.
Ivy L.: courier tracking uploaded: DHL 7733-2211. i'll meet courier at dock at 13:45. also the visitor asked if we have a no-flash policy for photos — asked that we avoid flash near the dog.
Sam (People Ops): noted re: no-flash. quick seat/escort poll: who can escort from lobby at 2:10? react with :hand:.
Rosa G.: happy to escort at 2:10 and help with the badge sign-off.
Kenji (Facilities): small note: the poster tube is a little longer than standard; please ensure it stays horizontal on the dolly. i'll bring extra straps.
Frontdesk Bot: Badges printed at 2:05 using `visitor-access-notes-v1.pdf`. 2 badges ready in lobby tray. Note: `access needs: service dog, no-flash` added.
Mailroom Bot: Poster accepted at loading dock by Ivy L. at 13:48. Photo saved as `mail-photos/3188884444.jpg`. Tube labeled `POSTER-IVY-3188884444`.
Ivy L.: thanks all. one small hiccup — vendor printed 4 badges instead of 2 in the print job and the template mis-aligned one badge. Sam, can you confirm print settings so we avoid waste?
Sam (People Ops): ugh thanks for flagging. Front desk printer is set to double-up by default for that template. i'll change it to "single" and reprint corrected badge if needed.
Rosa G.: re: dog comfort — i'll bring a small water bowl and towel, and Kat from Security said dog-friendly route from north entrance is cleared.
Kenji (Facilities): moving the bench by the planter will give a slightly larger calm space. i'll shift it at 14:00.
Sam (People Ops): checklist: 1) DHL poster accepted and labeled, 2) badges printed with `visitor-access-notes-v1.pdf` and reprint fixed, 3) calm corner reserved and bench moved, 4) escort assigned (Rosa), 5) no-flash note added. ping me if anything else. :white_check_mark:
Ivy L.: all set — i'll be at the lobby at 2:05. thanks everyone :)
